subject: combining transformed parameters and model blocks

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: combining transformed parameters and model blocks
parts:
Hi all. I’m thinking we should combine the transformed parameters and model blocks. My rationale has to do with reparameterizations such as the Matt trick. I find it awkward when writing a model to have to figure out which blocks to put things in. If the only difference between being in “transformed parameters” and “model” is which things get saved, I’d rather we indicate that in a different way. Of course I’m probably missing something here, we can discuss in the meeting today.
See you
A
